back: Incidence: new cases in a period. Prevalence: all people with the disease at one time.
Endemic: always present. Epidemic: sudden local rise. Pandemic: spread across countries or continents.
Direct contact with blood and body fluids of sick people or bodies; fruit bats are the likely reservoir.
Isolation, contact tracing for 21 days, protective equipment, safe burials, vaccination of contacts.

front: Risk factors for coronary heart disease
back: Smoking, hypertension, high cholesterol, saturated-fat diet, inactivity, obesity, diabetes, age.

front: Why is the sickle cell allele common where malaria is common?
back: Heterozygote advantage: carriers are partly protected against severe malaria.

front: Why can prevalence rise while incidence falls?
back: Treatment keeps people alive longer, so more people live with the disease.
Use rates; check sample size, reporting and testing; correlation is not causation.
